d:
What happens when a love triangle puts your friendship to the test?
After Tanya catches Ruhi and Rahul together, the two best friends are left picking up the pieces of their friendship. But as Tanya tries to make Ruhi see the red flags she missed, Ruhi begins to realise that Rahul may have been giving them both the same signals all along.
Was the real problem ever between Ruhi and Tanya, or was Rahul playing them both?
Watch Part 2 of this college love triangle as friendship, heartbreak, mixed signals and relationship drama collide.
